slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the warehouse capacity limit of 500 units a constraint on the inventory level at the end of each month, or on the total inventory held at any point during the month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the timing/scope of the capacity constraint, which is related to when inventory peaks, but did not explicitly ask when purchases occur within the month (e.g., beginning vs end).

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The timing of purchases within each month does not need to be specified; the monthly inventory balance equation and end-of-month capacity check are sufficient.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether purchases occur at the beginning or end of the month, and the user only confirmed that capacity applies at month-end, not the purchase timing.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without explicitly resolving the P1 purchase-timing slot; the related capacity-timing question did not confirm when purchases occur.

summary: The agent clarified many boundary facts (objective, limits, integrality, horizon inventory) but missed the specific purchase-timing hidden fact, only touching the related capacity-timing issue before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
